Claude's principal defer/open dispositions are conservative and byte-consistent. Agreement is not complete because its Q1 scope widening conflicts with the round-2 content that its own Q0 reaches; Q8 adds an unrecorded universal measurement triad; G3-G18 misstates the lawful later-successor route; G3-HOSTILE leaves stale pre-D-300 framing unresolved; G21-SCHEMA conflates schema and delivery-form blockers; and G21-NT6 reverses the agreed opening-before-fixture sequence.

A later reviewed G18 implementation successor is expressly contemplated by the live lifecycle join and does not contradict D-311.
The recorded D-300 hostile-goldens artifact supersedes the pre-D-300 count framing for current measurement purposes.
A truncated-body witness is a delivery-form question, not a per-type-schema question.
The agreed B2 programme places NT-6 fixture work after the Class A opening, not before it.
